meta.title: ResumeGPT — Self-hosted AI CV & cover letter workspace
meta.description: ResumeGPT is a self-hosted workspace that tailors CVs and cover letters to every job opportunity with a multi-agent LLM pipeline, scheduled job discovery, and reusable templates.
meta.ogDescription: Profile management, job tracking, scheduled job discovery, reusable templates, and a multi-agent LLM pipeline — all in one self-hosted app.

hero.titleHtml: Tailor every CV and cover letter with AI agents you control.
hero.lead: ResumeGPT combines profile management, job tracking, scheduled job discovery, reusable templates, and a multi-agent LLM pipeline in one self-hosted workspace — so every application gets a document actually written for it.
hero.note: Pulls the pre-built latest images from CI — the full stack is up in seconds. No account, no cloud dependency required.

howItWorks.title: From a saved profile to a reviewed PDF
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps, most of which only need to happen once.

profile.title: Add a Profile
profile.desc: Save your experience, skills, and target role once — reuse it for every application.

job.title: Track a Job
job.desc: Add an opportunity manually, or import public LinkedIn/Indeed URLs in bulk.

template.title: Pick a Template
template.desc: Use a LaTeX template, or leave it empty and let an agent design the layout.

generate.title: Generate & Review
generate.desc: Writer, Designer, and Visual Reviewer agents draft, render, and inspect the PDF.

features.title: Everything a focused job search needs
features.subtitle: One application instead of a pile of documents, prompts, and spreadsheets.

profiles.title: Reusable Profiles
profiles.desc: Save your experience once — import it from TXT, Markdown, TeX, DOC, DOCX, PDF, or images — then generate as many tailored documents as you need.

jobs.title: Track & Import Jobs
jobs.desc: Add roles manually or import up to 50 public URLs at once. The Job Import Agent handles pages outside the fast-path extractors.

hunter.title: Automated Job Hunter
hunter.desc: Schedule an agent to search the web on a recurring basis and surface new roles that match your goals — deduplicated automatically.

templates.title: LaTeX or AI-Designed Layouts
templates.desc: Bring your own LaTeX template, or let the Document Designer Agent build a print-ready HTML/CSS layout from scratch.

generation.title: Multi-Agent Generation
generation.desc: Writer, Template Applying / Document Designer, and Visual Reviewer agents collaborate — with up to two automatic layout-repair rounds.

llm.title: Bring Your Own LLM
llm.desc: Mix OpenAI, OpenAI-compatible, and local Ollama providers, with a different default model per agent role.

screenshots.title: A look inside the workspace
screenshots.subtitle: Click any screenshot to zoom in.

overview.title: Workspace overview
overview.desc: Profiles, job opportunities, templates, providers, and generated PDFs at a glance.

jobs.title: Job Opportunities
jobs.desc: Track status and source, and queue a CV or cover letter for any listing.

hunter.title: Job Hunter
hunter.desc: Scheduled searches that surface new opportunities automatically.

templates.title: Templates
templates.desc: The built-in Rezume LaTeX template alongside an uploaded custom one.

generation.title: Live generation
generation.desc: Staged PDF preview during generation, shown here for a Japanese résumé.

settings.title: Agent model routing
settings.desc: Choose a provider and model independently for every agent role.

manualBand.title: Need the full user manual?
manualBand.subtitle: A complete walkthrough of every screen and setting is on its way.

cta.title: Self-host it in one command
cta.subtitle: Docker Compose supplies development defaults, storage volumes, and database migrations out of the box.

manualPage.description: The full ResumeGPT user manual is on its way. In the meantime, the GitHub README covers setup, configuration, and every feature.
manualPage.heading: The user manual is on its way.
manualPage.body: We're writing a full, step-by-step walkthrough of every screen — Profiles, Job Opportunities, Job Hunter, Templates, Generation, and Settings. Until it's ready, the GitHub README covers installation, configuration, and every feature in detail.
